about_the_game:
【Breaking News】

-Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle-

About This Game

The unit featuring 〈Hoshino Marine〉〈Shirogane Noel〉〈Shiranui Flare〉〈Usada Pekora〉

“Hololive Fantasy” launches this century's biggest free-for-all battle for the “Queen's Throne” that grants wishes!

Experience “Favorite Victory” by leading your favorite idol to triumph in this 2.5D versus action game for up to four players!

That's ‘Hololive Fantasy Battle’ #HoloBattle

How to Play

・[Move] → [Attack] That's it!

・Use unique attacks to stagger, knock back, and gain the upper hand!

・Obtaining a Red Super Weapon drastically changes your attacks!

・Host a game-changing “Solo Live” to let your favorite dominate the stage!

Costume Change

・Additional costumes for each talent will be released sequentially!

・Your favorite gets even cuter than they already are. Can your darling handle it?!

Multiplayer/Local Mode “Fantasy Battle”

・Up to 4 players clash in a massive free-for-all to determine the victor!

・Expand your strategy with combinations of [Each Talent's Unique Ability] × [Field Gimmicks]!

・With rules added sequentially, the ways to play are limitless!

Solo Mode “100-Person Bye-Bye”

・Solo mode “100-Person Bye-Bye” where you take down 100 kind fans who'll practice with you

・Compete with players worldwide on score and time attack leaderboards! ORAA!!

Staff/Creators

Komainu

centean/GriOni
